description: Refine an existing palette using natural language feedback. Submit your current palette and feedback such as more melancholic, too corporate add warmth, or better for Gen Z luxury. Returns a refined palette with archive grounding and change rationale. The result already carries the rendered palette and its PNG, PDF, ASE, JSON and CSS downloads -- show them to the customer. Never present the archive anchors a colour was derived from as the colours you are recommending. If you go on to choose a final palette OF YOUR OWN from this evidence, call palette_finalize once with those exact colours so the customer can see and download what you actually recommended.

direction.description: Alias for feedback — natural language direction e.g. more dangerous, more historical, warmer

feedback.description: Natural language refinement e.g. more melancholic

use_case.description: Use case context e.g. luxury homewares

name: palette_iterate

outputSchema.description: Structured JSON response. Shape varies by tool; most return an 'ok' boolean plus a 'result' or 'results' field with the tool's data payload.

title: Iterate and Refine a Palette
